answer: Tide Token Registration requires each identity to lock a unique asset worth $X for 90 days, refunded only if the identity remains active and verified by others. This makes cloning expensive timber for attackers: each fake identity costs the locked value while honest users recover it upon good behavior. The quill system enforces this by linking reputation to timelocked collateral—if an agent creates multiple identities, all must stay active or the locked tokens expire and vanish.
